💁 3-layer enforcement ship. Layer1 in-tool guard: work_session.py end --early-confirm flag + phantom-payroll skip salary for no-contribute workers. Layer2 audit nag: subconscious.py scan-audit cmd 跑 work_session_audit/*.jsonl 抓 early-end + phantom-payroll. Layer3 Stop hook 加 scan-audit (Layer2 自動觸發). 加 2 new anti-pattern: direct-json-edit-bypass + commit-mixed-chat-and-code. Smoke test: scan-audit retroactively 抓到今天兩個 ws-session 違規, violation count 升到 5. Commit: UCL_Core f7f6583, UCL ce3c441, 主專案 08ee185a.
